svg.title: Agentic extraction wins only above about 100 line items
svg.desc: Single-pass · Haiku 5.5: 70 documents, running median 73% at 2, 80% at 6, 66% at 16, 53% at 61, 2% at 247; Agentic · Haiku 5.5: 70 documents, running median 58% at 2, 60% at 6, 60% at 16, 53% at 61, 54% at 247; Single-pass · Sonnet 5.5: 70 documents, running median 77% at 2, 63% at 6, 67% at 16, 52% at 61, 2% at 247; Agentic · Sonnet 5.5: 70 documents, running median 80% at 2, 80% at 6, 69% at 16, 58% at 61, 61% at 247
svg.text: Agentic extraction wins only above about 100 line items
